info.title: GetHired browser API
info.description: Implemented authentication surface after extraction to Express. Browser requests use the Next.js same-origin proxy. The backend additionally requires a server-only X-GetHired-Gateway credential except on GET /api/health/live. Cookies remain HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax/Path=/ with no Domain. Signup, recovery, business endpoints and readiness are future phases. All controlled errors use the JSON envelope; HEAD has no response body. Unsupported methods return 405 with Allow; unknown paths return 404. AUTH_ENABLED=false returns safe 503 for auth routes. B6 category/question-bank operations are included below; see backend-b6-question-bank.md. Earlier B1 documentation of future business work is historical.

get.description: Issues or reuses the browser binding and returns its CSRF token. Cross-site bootstrap is rejected; refresh the token after login binding rotation.

post.description: Validates Supabase credentials and active application account. Issues access/refresh/binding cookies. Returns no provider credentials.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Token from csrf bootstrap for the current browser binding.

get.description: Checks JWT plus live provider/application account and session state. Does not extend idle activity.

post.description: Rotates provider credentials within the original active session deadline. Access JWT may be expired; refresh and signed browser binding remain required.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Token from csrf bootstrap for the current browser binding.

post.description: Revokes the bound current session then clears all three cookies. Anonymous/stale access credentials are accepted with valid CSRF binding; it does not log out other devices.

parameters.description: Token from csrf bootstrap for the current browser binding.
